prior_evidence_search.exact_contract: EMA3 versus EMA6; three-bar price momentum; EMA6 slope; TP=max(0.5*ATR6,1.5*decision observed spread); six completed-M5-bar max age; 1000 base units; RAW_SIGNAL/EXECUTABLE_BASE/ADVERSE_STRESS

calibration.use: fixed-config measurement and causal feature warm-up only; no parameter selection

discovery.use: preregistered discovery gate; no configuration selection

locked_validation.use: decoded only after independent review and a fixed-config discovery lock

strategy.mid_price: arithmetic midpoint of BID and ASK OHLC field
strategy.ema_seed: first close in the exact seven-bar causal tail
strategy.direction: LONG when EMA3>EMA6, SHORT when EMA3<EMA6; equality emits no signal
strategy.slow_slope: EMA6 over seven-bar tail minus EMA6 over the first six bars of that tail
strategy.entry_rule: emit only when direction*momentum>0 and direction*slow_slope>0

chronology.decision_time: completed source bar start plus 300 seconds
chronology.fill: first exact source M5 open whose source timestamp is strictly greater than decision_time
chronology.max_age_precedence: max-age exit at the due bar open precedes that bar intrabar TP
chronology.split_boundary: positions are not carried between splits; pending orders expire and open positions liquidate at the last executable close inside the split

EXECUTABLE_BASE.entry_fill: eligible bar ask open for LONG, bid open for SHORT

ADVERSE_STRESS.latency_proxy: one quote-event cannot be reconstructed from M5; use the eligible fill-bar worst executable extreme plus 0.3 pip per side
ADVERSE_STRESS.entry_fill: ask high plus 0.3 pip for LONG, bid low minus 0.3 pip for SHORT

execution_arms.tp_fill: frozen target when the executable favorable side first reaches it; adverse exit subtracts 0.3 pip per side
execution_arms.max_age_or_terminal_fill: same-event midpoint for RAW; executable BID/ASK for BASE; executable BID/ASK plus adverse 0.3 pip for STRESS

inventory_and_gap_policy.gap_halt: an open lot is liquidated at the last executable close before a source gap and inventory resets; no price is synthesized

jpy_conversion.AUD_USD_and_EUR_USD: positive USD PnL converts at causal USD_JPY bid; negative USD PnL at causal USD_JPY ask
jpy_conversion.intrabar_tp_rate: exact same-source-time USD_JPY open because no causal intrabar cross-rate path is stored
jpy_conversion.missing_exact_conversion: JPY PnL is null and the admission gate fails

statistics.multiple_comparison_correction: none; one fixed runtime configuration, no selection
statistics.cluster: UTC decision day across all symbols
statistics.n_eff: Kish effective count of UTC decision-day trade-count weights, also report active day clusters
statistics.block_bootstrap: moving five-UTC-day block resampling of daily aggregate PnL divided by daily trade count

required_metrics: raw proposals and cost-pass count without an entry cost gate
same-signal fanout, fills, capacity blocks, missing strict fills
direction accuracy at max-age horizon, MFE, MAE and TP hit time
gross midpoint edge, observed spread, slippage, latency proxy and net edge
inventory count, age Q50/Q90/Q99, terminal liquidation and terminal open MTM
N_eff, five-day block-bootstrap LCB, equity multiple and max drawdown

failure_conditions: any preregistration, runtime binding, dataset prefix or review receipt hash mismatch
any semantic decode at or after 2025-08-28T04:05:00Z
any incomplete, non-M5, non-BA, crossed, duplicate, out-of-order or noncausal row
any missing exact fill or JPY conversion silently synthesized
any nonfinite accounting or leverage/size fitting
pass_fail.interpretation: a pass is an internal historical-replay gate only; it is not a guarantee, live-profit proof, strategy admission, or authority to trade

limitations: M5 BID/ASK OHLC does not reconstruct OANDA quote-event sequence, partial fill, queue position or exact intrabar spread path.
The adverse latency arm is a declared conservative fill-bar envelope, not an exact reproduction of one live quote event.
Fees and financing are set to zero for this OANDA spread vehicle with a maximum thirty-minute contract; both remain explicit fields.
Locked validation ends in 2025-08 and is not current forward shadow evidence.
No result can guarantee future profit.
